notes: Appearance audit update: Appearance now contains Hair Color, Eye Color, Skin Tone, Scars, Health Notes, and Full Physical Description. Hair Color, Eye Color, and Skin Tone use labeled visual swatch pickers. Health, Disabilities, and Injuries are combined into Health Notes. Removed Appearance fields are no longer shown. Existing compatible values are migrated where possible; character data and portraits remain in the separate user-data folder.
